t2 [wave1-web] COMPLETED. Report delivered as task output (read-only; no files written).

Headline findings for the codebase summary:
- Stack: React 19 + Vite 6 + react-router-dom v7 + antd 5 + TanStack Query v5 + @dnd-kit; contracts shared via `@mahalla-ovozi/api-contracts` (workspace:*).
- Shell: `apps/web/src/App.tsx` — single module-level QueryClient (staleTime 30s, gcTime 10m, retry 2, no refetchOnWindowFocus); provider chain AppErrorBoundary > QueryClient > ConfigProvider > AntdApp > AuthProvider > BrowserRouter > DistrictProvider > LiveAnnouncer > TopicReadState > Suspense; 13 lazy-loaded routes; `/` is role-discriminating via `AuthenticatedRoot` (DISTRICT_HOKIM → HokimDashboardPage, else ConsoleLayout with 8-item sidebar).
- Auth: `src/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx` gates on isLoading / isAuthenticated / mustChangePassword. `auth-context.tsx` runs the session query + a 5s expiresAt watchdog that clears cache and hard-navigates to /sign-in.
- Data layer invariant: every response is Zod-validated in `src/lib/api-client.ts` against api-contracts schemas (`INVALID_RESPONSE` on mismatch); `credentials:'include'`; typed `ApiError` with code/statusCode/isNetworkError/blockers.
- Domain: 5-lane kanban (`components/topics/FiveLaneBoard.tsx`, HOKIM_RELATED/WATER/ELECTRICITY/GAS/WASTE) is the core Hokim UI; console side covers districts, system-health, telegram-setup, subscriptions, hokim-accounts, ai-operations, audit-history.
- Tests: 71 vitest unit files (`tests/unit/`) + 8 Playwright specs (`tests/e2e/`), single chromium, workers 1, boots backend with `mahalla_ovozi_test` DB. Convention is getByRole + Uzbek accessible names; only 14 `data-testid` in src.
- Scripts: only `scripts/check-bundle-budgets.js` (700KB max chunk, 250KB vendor-react, 50KB vendor-query, 200KB Table).

Top risks worth carrying into the final summary:
1. No per-route role guard — nested PRODUCT_OWNER routes only have ProtectedRoute, so a DISTRICT_HOKIM can navigate directly to /districts, /subscriptions, /hokim-accounts, /ai-operations, /audit-history.
2. Zero optimistic updates (0 `onMutate`) and no global QueryCache/MutationCache onError — mutations are invalidate-after-await, errors rendered per-component.
3. Query-key factory `src/district/query-keys.ts` (AD-10) is only used by the district domain; ~51 other queryKey sites are raw literals.
4. Three overlapping API-client locations: `src/lib/api-client.ts`, `src/api/*-client.ts`, and per-domain `src/{district,topics,health,issues}/*-client.ts`.
5. No i18n layer — all copy hardcoded Uzbek Cyrillic inline; plus an English accessible name leak (`/Close/i`) in AuditHistoryPage.
6. Two divergent palettes: antd tokens #F8FAFC/#0F172A vs `src/index.css:32-33` #F5F7F6/#172321, and a third focus color #007A7C; components still hardcode hex inline despite `themeColors`.
7. Dead code: `src/pages/ProtectedLandingPage.tsx` exported but referenced nowhere.
8. 404 is a blanket `Navigate to="/" replace` (App.tsx:159).
9. E2E gap: no specs for Hokim kanban, subscriptions, audit, AI operations, system health.
10. Undetermined: production /api routing lives outside apps/web (no VITE_* use in src); whether `apps/web/dist/` is a committed artifact; no lint/format script in apps/web/package.json.

Full detail with line references is in the task output field.

t1 COMPLETE (attempt_id 01310bce-b1db-48f0-a44c-cf5898fdce75, status=completed). Full structured markdown report is stored as the task output. Strictly read-only: no files created/edited/deleted, no tests/migrations/docker/servers run.

Headlines for downstream consumers:

1) RUNTIME: 4 entrypoints, one image (Dockerfile target `runner`, deploy/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml runs backend/worker/userbot with different `command`s). `apps/backend/src/entrypoints/http.ts` (340 L) builds Fastify 5 with fastify-type-provider-zod compilers, cookie, compress (threshold 1024), CORS from APP_ORIGIN, sanitized setErrorHandler (L154-244), setNotFoundHandler; then `boss.start()`+`initBossQueues()` L260-261 and registers 16 route plugins in fixed order via `registerAllDomainRoutes()` L56-87. `worker.ts` (265 L) wires 4 HttpProviderAdapters -> AiGateway -> 3 evaluators + SystemBackupRetentionVerifier -> `registerWorkerPipelines()` L197, plus 60 s Telegram webhook watchdog. `userbot.ts` (108 L) starts UserbotConnectionManager. `reconcile-restore.ts` (69 L) is the post-pgBackRest CLI. NO central config module — every consumer reads process.env directly; only `src/cli/verify-deepinfra.ts` imports dotenv/config.

2) MODULES: 16 domain modules under apps/backend/src/modules/ (~58 route registrations, all /api/v1/*). Full per-module table (responsibility + every method/path + key services) is in the stored output. Largest: topics (topic-query-engine 1110 L, topic-evidence-management-service 1223 L, hokim-topics-routes 383 L), subscriptions (service 1062 L, district-deletion-service 723 L), ai (district-analysis-settings-service 534 L), health (health-checker 844 L).

3) PORTS/ADAPTERS: hexagon direction holds (adapters import domain ports). AI (`AiProviderAdapterPort` -> HttpProviderAdapter for OPENAI/GEMINI/DEEPINFRA/OLLAMA + MockProviderAdapter, wired worker.ts:172-178); Telegram Bot (`TelegramClientPort` + 8-class error hierarchy); MTProto (`UserbotClientPort` with a compile-time write-method ban `_AssertOnlyPort`, `UserbotAuthClientPort`); backup (`BackupRetentionVerifier` -> SystemBackupRetentionVerifier reading pgBackRest); tombstones (`ExternalTombstoneStore` -> FileExternalTombstoneStore). Crypto has NO port interface.

4) DATA: 17 schema modules / 21 tables, 28 SQL migrations (drizzle/0000-0028). Tenant scoping is layered: district_id FK on every domain table (CASCADE, except two deliberate RESTRICT legal-evidence anchors), district-first composite indexes, app-level `createRequireAuth({allowMatchingDistrictOnly})` and per-service `validateDistrictScope()`.

5) CROSS-CUTTING: cookie session `mahalla_session` (12 h sliding / 24 h absolute, credential_version invalidation, 60 s touch throttle); 13 pg-boss queues with typed `BossQueueMap`, 4 cron sweeps (UTC), transactional enqueue via `withTransactionalIntake()`; audit writes with recursive sanitization.

6) TESTS: 85 suites, `fileParallelism:false`, real-Postgres integration against `mahalla_ovozi_test` (localhost:5433) — no setupFiles/globalSetup.

TOP RISKS worth surfacing in the final summary: (a) `deploy/compose/.env.example` advertises AI_PROVIDER=GROQ + GROQ_API_KEY but the gateway only supports OPENAI|GEMINI|DEEPINFRA|OLLAMA -> following it verbatim breaks all AI jobs; (b) three disagreeing AI defaults (ai-config.ts DEEPINFRA/DeepSeek-V4-Flash vs seeds.ts OLLAMA/gemma4:12b vs vitest.config.ts OLLAMA); (c) mixed validation boundary — only 22 routes use Fastify `schema:{}` while 36 use manual `.safeParse()`, so validation error shapes are non-uniform; (d) `verifyStateChangingOrigin` (CSRF) is applied only to some mutating scopes, not globally; (e) `token-cipher.ts` has a hardcoded FALLBACK_DEV_KEY when ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing; (f) `drizzle/meta/` snapshot drift vs migrations 0005/0006/0015/0017/0020-0024; (g) `http.ts:260` calls boss.start() unconditionally, so API+worker+userbot each open pgboss pools (max 10) alongside pg pool max 20. UNVERIFIED: whether /api/v1/health/live and /ready sit inside the createRequireProductOwner-guarded scope at health-routes.ts:245-246 (prod healthcheck curls /live unauthenticated, which implies outside); the >700-line files listed above were only partially read; root docker-compose.yml, deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml (dev) and Caddyfile not read.

Member "backend-scout" hit an unrecoverable turn failure: RATE_LIMITED: DeepSeek 网页版 网页端限流（Messages too frequent. Try again later.）— 将退避后重试 (code UNKNOWN). Task t3 ("Summarize shared contracts, deployment/infra, and root tooling") was marked failed; reassign it or retry when ready.

t3 COMPLETE (attempt_id 057a0808-5e41-436f-affe-8457d2d7618e, status=completed). Full structured markdown report is stored as the task output. Headlines for the final summary:

1) CONTRACTS: packages/api-contracts is a genuinely pure browser-safe package — a repo-wide search for node:/drizzle/pg/pg-boss/fastify/dotenv/process.env across packages/api-contracts/src returned ZERO matches, enforced by construction + tsconfig include (no lint/build boundary guard exists). 17 modules re-exported from src/index.ts, 7 test files. Naming is consistent (<Thing>Schema / <Thing>Dto / <Action>Request|ResponseSchema / createKeysetPageSchema). Shared primitives: ApiErrorEnvelopeSchema, IsoDateStringSchema, DistrictIdSchema (comment cites AD-9), TashkentCalendarDay. It actively defends the boundary: analysis-settings.ts exports PROHIBITED_SECRET_PATTERNS + containsProhibitedSecrets() + applySecretCheck(). Versioning is flat 0.1.0 + workspace:* only; the real versioning is domain-level (ai_profiles.version/promptVersion/schemaVersion).

2) CONSUMPTION (links to t1/t2): 57 import sites in apps/backend/src, 96 in apps/web/src — the package is load-bearing on both sides, not decorative.

3) DEPLOY: Dockerfile = 5 stages (base/deps/builder/runner/caddy); ONE image, three roles via different commands (http.ts / worker.ts / userbot.ts), and the SPA is baked into the CADDY image (no separate web container). prod compose = postgres:16-alpine + backend (healthcheck curl /api/v1/health/live) + worker + userbot + caddy(80/443); network mahalla-net; volumes postgres_data/caddy_data/caddy_config. Caddyfile = HSTS/nosniff/DENY/strict-origin/empty-Permissions-Policy, /api/*→backend:3000, /assets/* immutable, catch-all try_files→index.html, domain mahalla-ovozi.uz + www.

4) VPS MODEL: ssh alias airnet-vps (or mahalla-vps), /opt/mahalla-ovozi, Ubuntu 24.04, passwordless key-only (no secrets in repo), root scripts pnpm vps:status / vps:logs. DR runbook: RPO<=1h / RTO<=8h, 6-step procedure, fail-closed readiness gate (503 until restoreReconciliation ok), 17-table purge.

5) ROOT TOOLING: pnpm workspaces apps/* + packages/*, catalog covers only 5 shared toolchain pins (typescript/zod/vitest/dotenv/@types/node) with 12 references total; tsconfig.base.json has erasableSyntaxOnly:true (explains the zod-enum-not-TS-enum style) and noUncheckedIndexedAccess:true; CI is a single validate job (postgres:18 service → migrate → typecheck → test → playwright) with NO build/lint/deploy stage; .npmrc engine-strict=true.

TOP RISKS actually observed (19 total in the stored report; these are the load-bearing ones):
- R1: DR runbook step 1 runs `caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.maintenance` but deploy/compose/Caddyfile.maintenance is ABSENT — step 1 of disaster recovery cannot execute.
- R2: DR runbook step 3 runs `docker compose run --rm pgbackrest ...` but NO pgbackrest service exists in prod compose (only an apt package in the runner image) — restore cannot proceed as documented. (ADR-0008 documents pgBackRest WAL archiving to S3, so the mechanism is intended but the runbook's invocation is unmatched.)
- R3: deploy/compose/.env.example advertises AI_PROVIDER=GROQ + GROQ_API_KEY; no GROQ adapter exists (only OPENAI|GEMINI|DEEPINFRA|OLLAMA) → following it breaks every AI job.
- R4: Postgres major skew — prod 16-alpine vs dev/CI 18-alpine.
- R5: api-contracts exports map resolves '.' to ./src/index.ts while main/types point at ./dist/* → committed dist/ is orphaned and can silently drift.
- R6: deploy/README.md documents `docker compose pull && up -d` but prod compose has `build:` with no `image:` key → pull is a no-op and the VPS will rebuild.
- R9: worker and userbot have NO healthchecks despite both depending on backend:service_healthy and restart:unless-stopped.
- R13: .dockerignore does not exclude tests/ or docs/, and Dockerfile:36 copies all of /app from builder → the production image ships ~28k lines of test corpus.
- R15: runtime never uses compiled output — all three entrypoints run `node --import tsx/esm` against src/, so prod executes TS transpiled at container start.
- R19: FileExternalTombstoneStore's cwd-relative default resolved to apps/backend/deploy/backup/tombstones.json in this working tree — a DIFFERENT file from the deploy/backup/tombstones.json that prod compose and the DR runbook assume; both are gitignored (verified: `**/tombstones.json`) so the divergence is invisible in VCS.
- Also: duplicate postgres service in root vs deploy/compose dev compose (root file is what `pnpm db:up` uses, so the dev userbot service is unreachable from any root script); empty root scripts/ dir; test_ssh*.log files sitting at repo root; @types/node catalog pinned ^22 against engines.node >=24; doc/code mismatch (runbook cites /api/v1/audit/history, backend registers /api/v1/audit/events).

UNVERIFIED (explicitly, not guessed): docs/adr/0008 and 0009 were not read in full (their titles suggest they may already accept the R6 pull-vs-build and userbot-risk postures); no `docker compose config` was run; apps/web/scripts/check-bundle-budgets.js was not read and no CI step invokes it; skills-lock hashes were compared by name only.

t4 [wave2-docs-architecture] COMPLETED. Full report is in the t4 task output field. Read-only: no files written, nothing executed.

HEADLINE FINDINGS for the final codebase summary:

1. CONTEXT.md (58 lines) is the vocabulary authority: 9 canonical terms each with a product UI label and explicit avoid-synonyms — District/*Tuman* (avoid tenant, workspace, organization, account, city), Mahalla, Hokim (holds ZERO admin privileges), Product Owner/*Mahsulot egasi*, Accepted Evidence/*Qabul qilingan dalil* (verbatim raw Telegram message), Topic/*Mavzu* (bound to one Asia/Tashkent calendar day, never rolls over), Lane/*Yo'nalish* (Suv/Elektr/Gaz/Chiqindi/Hokimiyatga oid), Signal, Audit Record/*Audit yozuvi*. Plus 7 technical invariants (pnpm 10.x strict TS ESM; Fastify 5 + pg-boss from one image; React 19 + Vite 6 + antd 5 + TanStack Query 5; Zod contracts where DB rows and SDK objects never cross the boundary; UTC timestamptz stored / Asia/Tashkent derived; mahalla_ovozi_test isolation; single-host Compose on Airnet.uz for TAS-IX/UZ-IX sovereignty).

2. All 9 ADRs (0001-0009, all status:accepted) are REFLECTED in code — none is unimplemented. 0001 hexagonal modules+adapters, 0002 pg-boss transactional intake via withTransactionalIntake (boss-client.ts:222), 0003 same-day Tashkent boundary, 0004 optimistic AI stale-rejection (partially verified), 0005 provider-neutral ai_profiles gateway, 0006 explicit district_id scoping with no RLS, 0007 stateful DB sessions not JWT, 0008 single-host Compose + Caddy + pgBackRest (RPO<=1h/RTO<=8h), 0009 userbot transport.

3. ADR-0009 (userbot) is FULLY BUILT, not aspirational: GramJsUserbotClient behind UserbotClientPort with a COMPILE-TIME passive-only guard (userbot-client-port.ts:27,47 `_AssertPassiveOnlyPort = ValidateNoWriteMethods<...>`), DB-enforced CHECK (source='BOT_API' AND telegramBotId IS NOT NULL) OR (source='USERBOT' AND telegramBotId IS NULL) (telegram-intakes.ts:42-45), transport-aware resolver with no botId (telegram-intake-service.ts:171-245), dedicated `userbot` Compose service, AES-256-GCM session bootstrap, and ban containment raising a District-scoped Critical Operational Issue (userbot-connection-manager.ts:456-457,503,513).

4. TOP RISK — a colliding, non-existent ADR series. docs/adr/ holds exactly 0001-0009 (glob-verified), yet code/tests/runbooks cite AD-03, AD-09, AD-10, AD-11 (~36 sites) which exist NOWHERE as files. The numbers even collide semantically: file 0003 is "Same-Day Calendar Boundary" but cited AD-03 is "Tenant District Isolation" (hokim-topics-pagination.test.ts:594-595). AD-10 (query-key factory, district/query-keys.ts:2), AD-09 (search never serialized to URL — HokimDashboardPage.tsx:42), AD-11 (privacy-safe telemetry + DR/deletion reconciliation — webhook-security.ts:41, health-checker.ts:35, deploy/backup/runbook.md:3,12). A reader following AGENTS.md:6 to docs/adr/ for the cited invariant finds the wrong doc or nothing. The react-query audit already flagged AD-10 alone as Phase 6; the problem is materially broader.

5. No requirements baseline in the repo. FR-12, FR-32, NFR-4 are cited as governing IDs (deploy/backup/runbook.md:3, reconcile-restore.ts:9, restore-reconciliation.ts:49,158, topic-retention-service.ts:65, external-tombstone-store.port.ts:6) but a grep for FR-|NFR- across *.md matched only runbook.md:3, and no requirements/PRD doc exists under docs/. Every FR/NFR traceability claim is currently unresolvable.

6. docs/architecture-review.md CONTRADICTS ITSELF: its §1 table still rates Backend Domain & Pipelines FRICTION and names the 1,344-line ai/ service and shallow worker handlers as live problems, while §2-§3 declare all three deepening candidates COMPLETED and the closing line says the domain is "unified, deeply cohesive". I verified §2-§3 against the tree (topic-assignment-coordinator.ts, topic-query-engine.ts, topic-evidence-management-service.ts present; modules/ai/signal-management-service.ts absent) — §1 is stale.

7. spec-instant-telegram-group-onboarding.md is PARTIALLY implemented. Create path does set status:'VALID' (telegram-groups-service.ts:308) and the drawer is genuinely single-step with no countdown (TelegramGroupDrawer.tsx:35-70; grep countdown|TESTING|PENDING|simulate|startGroupTest → no matches). But the promised deletion did NOT happen: startGroupTestSession/getGroupTestStatus are still live routes (telegram-groups-routes.ts:275,292) and POST .../simulate-test-message still exists (:306-308), with the whole TESTING/TIMEOUT machine retained (telegram-group-engine.ts:35,79,92,125,157,226,297).

8. spec-userbot-transport.md contains a now-FALSE premise: decision 6 says "No MTProto dependency exists in the repo today; this is a greenfield dependency" — GramJS is implemented (userbot-client-adapter.ts:3-7,45).

9. docs/react-query-best-practices-audit.md (dated 2026-09-20) is the best-evidenced doc in the repo and AGREES with wave-1 findings. It corroborates: the 🔴 F1 cache-key collision on ['district-mahallas', districtId] (useDistrictMahallas.ts:10 string[] vs district-topics-client.ts:134 DistrictMahallasResponse); 🔴 F2 offline auth false-negative (isLoading === isPending && isFetching, so offline gives isLoading===false with data undefined → signed-in user bounced to /sign-in) — matches my ProtectedRoute.tsx:10 read; 🟡 F6 the 7 hand-written ['districts','list'] literals + the dangling AD-10; 🟡 F8 no global MutationCache/QueryCache onError + four console.error('Auth mutation failed:') in auth-context.tsx. Version reality: declared ^5.66.9, locked 5.101.4, latest 5.103.1, React 19.2.8, and there is NO TanStack Query v6 — no migration needed.

10. Governance (.agents/rules/) binding rules vs compliance: COMPLIED — runtime validation at boundaries (Zod both server via fastify-type-provider-zod and client in lib/api-client.ts:86-100); test DB isolation (playwright.config.ts:28 defaults to mahalla_ovozi_test); pure-functions-over-OOP (the 1,344-line OOP service was deleted; remaining classes are the allowed connector kinds). VIOLATED — no default parameter values (http.ts:301 PORT/HOST defaults; FiveLaneBoard.tsx:51); English-only comments (Uzbek strings throughout, though this rule is in real tension with the required localized Uzbek error messages — the rule may be what needs fixing); no silent recovery (two catch { /* ignore */ } in auth-context.tsx:113-116,121-123); no any (4+ eslint-suppressed any on withTransactionalIntake tx). Vocabulary enforcement is documentation-only — no test/lint/schema check enforces CONTEXT.md's avoid-synonyms, and the one historical violation was caught by a human architecture review.

SYNTHESIS: a multi-tenant civic situational-awareness platform (not a complaint/ticketing system, human always in the loop), built as a hexagonal modular monolith on a single-host Compose edge, where PostgreSQL is simultaneously system of record, queue (pg-boss), session store, and AI-profile store — DB connection pressure is the scaling limit.

Also flagged as UNVERIFIED rather than guessed: whether .agents/mcp_config.json + a working .grepai index exist (AGENTS.md:15-18 compliance unproven); whether the 3 legacy telegram-group test routes still have UI callers; whether the ADR-0009 ToS/consent written acceptances exist outside the workspace; whether an FR/NFR doc lives outside the repo; and whether ADR-0004's exact 50s debounce/serialized queues are implemented as stated.
